body: **Foco:** Laboratório de exame 8 (TOEFL · IELTS · college).
**Expressões:** The extent to which….
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** biografia.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo treinar uma redação de opinião (To what extent do you agree?) e usar The extent to which…

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Helena Barros (fictional social worker)
paras: Helena Barros grew up in a crowded flat on the edge of a large city. **Having been awarded** a scholarship, she studied social work and returned to her neighbourhood. Her first project was a homework club in a church hall.

Over twenty years, the club grew into a network of eight centres. Asked **the extent to which** one person can change a community, she answers: “That depends on **the extent to which** others join in.”

items.q: Helena grew up in a spacious house.
Her first project was a homework club.
She thinks one person can change a community alone.

frames.title: To what extent…? / The extent to which…

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: To what extent do you agree?
**The extent to which** governments act matters.
blocks.cap: To what extent…? / The extent to which…

blocks.body: **The extent to which…** = o grau em que. Usa-se como **sujeito**: *The extent to which families benefit varies.* Mostre posição parcial: *to some extent, to a large extent*.
Não responda só “yes/no”: a pergunta pede **grau**.

items.s: The extent to ___ families benefit varies. (which)
It depends on the extent to which others ___ in. (join)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Good Develop the idea in two paragraphs
items.pt: Bom. Desenvolva a ideia em dois parágrafos.

body: **The extent to which…** — O grau em que…
**To a certain extent,…** — Até certo ponto,…
**It all comes down to…** — Tudo se resume a…
**Make a difference** — Fazer diferença
**Give back to the community** — Retribuir à comunidade
**Safety in numbers** — Segurança na união
**Strength in unity** — Força na união
**Roll up one’s sleeves** — Arregaçar as mangas
**Good. Develop the idea in two paragraphs.** — Bom. Desenvolva a ideia em dois parágrafos.
**To what extent do you agree that individuals can change communities?** — Em que medida você concorda que indivíduos podem mudar comunidades?
**To a large extent, but they need support.** — Em grande medida, mas precisam de apoio.

prompts.q: Answer: To what extent do you agree?
prompts.model: To a large extent, I agree.
The extent to which people cooperate decides the outcome.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence essay outline and the introduction for: To what extent can individuals change their communities?
blocks.model: Introduction: Many people believe that individuals are powerless. To a large extent, I disagree, although change depends on support. Paragraph 1: examples of grassroots projects. Paragraph 2: the role of institutions. Conclusion: the extent to which others join in decides the outcome.

body: IELTS Writing Task 2: mínimo de 250 palavras; introdução com posição, dois argumentos desenvolvidos e conclusão.
Em To what extent, mostre o grau da sua concordância e justifique.
Reserve 5 minutos para planejar e 3 para revisar.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
